The Act asks the driver to 'first see that the movement can be made in safety' (142 (1)), to first ascertain 'that it can be done safely' (154 (1) (a)) and, for a pass, that the roadway be 'safely free' of approaching and overtaking traffic (148 (8)), with no measure.
